prompt.content: What was the maximum sustained wind speed of Hurricane Five, the strongest cyclone of the 1855 Atlantic hurricane season?

output:
Hurricane Five was the **strongest cyclone** of the **1855 Atlantic hurricane season**. It was a Category 4 hurricane when it made landfall in Cuba.

**Maximum sustained wind speed:**  
**135 mph (217 km/h)**

This is the highest wind speed ever recorded
